title: BrainTRACE: Tracing Longitudinal, Multimodal, and Volumetric Evidence in Brain MRI Clinical Reasoning
reasons: 医学、生物医学或临床专题，超出当前 Agent 与通用模型评测方向
missingSignals: 材料中提供代码或数据链接（未核验内容）
讨论泛化、污染、稳健性或人工核验

evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce BrainTRACE, a report-grounded benchmark for evaluating whether vision-language models can trace the evidence structure required for longitudinal brain MRI interpretation.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Brain MRI interpretation is a longitudinal clinical reasoning problem: radiologists compare serial studies, integrate information across MRI sequences, localize findings within volumetric anatomy, and translate this evidence into report-grounded assessments.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: We release the benchmark specification, evaluation lists, scoring implementation, scoring rubrics, and audit-record format to support reproducible progress in brain MRI VLM evaluation.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Brain MRI interpretation is a longitudinal clinical reasoning problem: radiologists compare serial studies, integrate information across MRI sequences, localize findings within volumetric anatomy, and translate this evidence into report-grounded assessments.

evidence.label: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围
evidence.excerpt: BrainTRACE contains 7,273 scored VQA instances derived from 1,778 longitudinal patients, 7,299 MRI studies, and approximately 29k co-registered 3D MRI sequence volumes.
